summary: Structural scope: two long side doors with their own glazing, fixed rear quarter panes, a rear-glazed hatch assembly, enclosed wells and a seated cabin.
notes: Three-quarter and new profile checked. Macro form remains stable. Mirror and bumper are still structural blocks; rounded housings, short circular headlamps, hatch corner lamps and eight-spoke rims remain form work. No final appearance claim.

features.notes: Hatch roof and short rear overhang maintained.
Four wheels with closed wells and real arch cutouts.
Two side doors, fixed quarter panes and seated cabin; rear glass and gaskets attached to hatch.
